question: In which of the following states is Buxa National Park situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

__
 
• The Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) is a **760-square-kilometre tiger reserve located inside the Buxa National Park in West Bengal, India**, in the Buxa Hills of the southern hilly area of **Bhutan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bird enthusiasts come here to watch and click photographs of the migratory birds that come to this region from colder regions of the northern hemisphere.
 
• Buxa is a heaven for bird enthusiasts and people can see rare Avian species here.
 
• It is a 4-day festival in which rare bird species like the greater spotted eagle and great Hornbill are expected to be seen.
 
• Buxa National Park is also a tiger reserve that was created in 1983 and is the 15th Tiger Reserve of India.
 
• There are around 284 bird species, 73 mammal species, 450 species of trees, 400 types of herbs, 10 species of bamboo, 150 species of orchids are some of the flora and fauna found in this park.
